===== active route =====
function route(view,source){view=canonical(view);window.__EXPORTHUB_NAVIGATION_ACTIVE_UNTIL__=Date.now()+1800;if(!canRoute(view)){if(source!=='history'&&source!=='popstate'&&source!=='boot'&&source!=='ready')alert('Dieser Bereich ist für deinen Benutzer nicht freigegeben.');return false}var now=Date.now();if(routeBusy||(view===lastRoute&&now-lastRouteAt<120)){duplicateRoutesBlocked++;return false}var previous=current();var cachedTarget=fastViewCache[view];if(cachedTarget&&canonical(cachedTarget.rendered||'')!==view)dropFastView(view);if(view!=='shipmentview'&&typeof window.__EXPORTHUB_RC843_RELEASE_SHIPMENT_VIEW__==='function'){try{window.__EXPORTHUB_RC843_RELEASE_SHIPMENT_VIEW__('route-'+view)}catch(_){}}routeBusy=true;lastRoute=view;lastRouteAt=now;routeCount++;try{
 if(previous!==view)stashFastView(previous);
 if(previous!==view&&view!=='cmr'&&restoreFastView(view,previous)){return false}
 var core=window.ExportHUBRC524;
 if(core&&typeof core.install==='function'&&core.diagnostics&&core.diagnostics().installed!==true){try{core.install()}catch(error){console.error('RC409 Navigation initialisieren',error)}}
 if(view==='shipmentsearch'&&window.ExportHUBShipmentView&&typeof window.ExportHUBShipmentView.renderSearch==='function'){setViewState(view);return window.ExportHUBShipmentView.renderSearch()}
 if(view==='shipmentview'&&window.ExportHUBShipmentView&&typeof window.ExportHUBShipmentView.render==='function'){setViewState(view);return window.ExportHUBShipmentView.render()}
 if(view==='documentviewer'&&window.ExportHUBDocumentViewer&&typeof window.ExportHUBDocumentViewer.render==='function'){setViewState(view);return window.ExportHUBDocumentViewer.render()}
 if(view==='cmr')return openDocuments();
 if(view==='warehouse'&&window.ExportHUBWarehouse&&typeof window.ExportHUBWarehouse.render==='function'){setViewState(view);prepareDirectView(view);var outWarehouse=window.ExportHUBWarehouse.render(false);finishDirectView(view);return outWarehouse}
  if(view==='diagnostics'){var diag=window.ExportHUBDiagnostics871||window.ExportHUBDiagnostics870;if(diag&&typeof diag.render==='function'){setViewState(view);prepareDirectView(view);return diag.render()}}
 if(view==='release'&&window.ExportHUBReleaseCenter562&&typeof window.ExportHUBReleaseCenter562.renderHtml==='function'){setViewState(view);var outRelease=prepareDirectView(view);if(outRelease){outRelease.innerHTML=window.ExportHUBReleaseCenter562.renderHtml();finishDirectView(view);if(releaseRefreshTimer)clearTimeout(releaseRefreshTimer);var ntRelease=window.ExportHUBClean&&window.ExportHUBClean.native&&window.ExportHUBClean.native.setTimeout||window.setTimeout;releaseRefreshTimer=ntRelease(function(){releaseRefreshTimer=0;if(current()!=='release')return;try{window.ExportHUBReleaseCenter562.refresh()}catch(error){console.error('Release-Center aktualisieren',error)}},900)}return false}
 if(view==='reports')return renderReports();
 if(view==='privacy')return renderPrivacy();
 if(view==='settings')return renderSettings();
 if(view==='notifications'&&window.ExportHUBIndex236&&typeof window.ExportHUBIndex236.open==='function'){setViewState(view);prepareDirectView(view);var outNotifications=window.ExportHUBIndex236.open();finishDirectView(view);return outNotifications}
 if((view==='shippingcosts'||view==='inspections'||view==='abd')&&!window.ExportHUBRC626&&!ensureRC626Controller()){console.error('ExportHUB: Versand/Prüfungen/ABD-Modul konnte nicht aktiviert werden.');return false}
 if(view==='shippingcosts'&&window.ExportHUBRC626&&typeof window.ExportHUBRC626.openShipping==='function'){setViewState(view);prepareDirectView(view);var outShipping=window.ExportHUBRC626.openShipping();finishDirectView(view);return outShipping}
 if(view==='inspections'&&window.ExportHUBRC626&&typeof window.ExportHUBRC626.openInspections==='function'){setViewState(view);prepareDirectView(view);var outInspections=window.ExportHUBRC626.openInspections();finishDirectView(view);return outInspections}
 if(view==='abd'&&window.ExportHUBRC626&&typeof window.ExportHUBRC626.openAbd==='function'){setViewState(view);prepareDirectView(view);var outAbd=window.ExportHUBRC626.openAbd(false);finishDirectView(view);return outAbd}
 if(core&&typeof core.setView==='function'){try{return core.setView(view)}catch(error){console.error('RC409 Bereich öffnen',error)}}
 console.error('ExportHUB Navigation: zentraler Renderer ist nicht verfügbar');
 return false
}finally{routeBusy=false;updateActive();if(current()===view){recordHistory(view,source);setTimeout(function(){try{if(typeof window.__EXPORTHUB_FINISH_NAV_LOADING__==='function')window.__EXPORTHUB_FINISH_NAV_LOADING__()}catch(_){}},120)}}}

===== shipment back =====
function back(){var s=state(),target=low(s.shipmentViewReturnView)||'shipmentoverview';rc843ReleaseViewGuard('back');if(target==='shipmentview'||target==='documentviewer')target='shipmentsearch';if(window.ExportHUBRC325&&typeof window.ExportHUBRC325.route==='function')return window.ExportHUBRC325.route(target,'shipment-view-back');return false}

===== shipment overview =====
function overview(){var target=low(state().shipmentViewReturnView)||'shipmentoverview';rc843ReleaseViewGuard('overview');if(target==='shipmentview'||target==='documentviewer')target='shipmentsearch';if(window.ExportHUBRC325&&typeof window.ExportHUBRC325.route==='function')return window.ExportHUBRC325.route(target,'shipment-view-context-back');return false}

===== document viewer back =====
function viewerBack(){var v=viewerPersist(),s=state();viewerClearUrl();if(v){s.shipmentViewId=q(v.shipmentId||v.reference);try{sessionStorage.removeItem('exporthub_document_viewer_v1')}catch(_){}viewerMemory=null}if(window.ExportHUBRC325&&typeof window.ExportHUBRC325.route==='function')return window.ExportHUBRC325.route('shipmentview','document-viewer-back');s.view='shipmentview';return render()}
